title_en: Great Poems and Songs (7/20): The Journey of "Jasmine Flower"
note_en: 对……来说 sets up whose point of view a statement is from, and it comes at the very start: 对很多中国人和外国人来说，"茉莉花"的旋律已经成了中国的一个文化符号 "For many Chinese people and foreigners, the melody of 'Jasmine Flower' has become a cultural symbol of China." English "for ..." can go at the beginning or the end, but Chinese keeps the frame up front. Don't confuse it with 对 alone, which means "toward" or "to," as in 对百姓的同情 "compassion for ordinary people."
